newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Heritage Media lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Heritage Media lowered.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analyst Matthew Harrigan said in a research note that he lowered his recommendation on Heritage Media Corp to market perform from buy.

-- The move was made "given yesterday's anticipated, albeit modest, 3/8 point pop (in share price) from the conclusion of the five-day due diligence period for the acquisition" of Heritage by News Corp Ltd.
-- In morning New York Stock Exchange trade, Heritage "A" shares were up 1/8 to 18-3/8.
